title: Trade pounds on an off-chain order book
summary: Alice signs two offers to sell pounds, kept off the chain; Bob buys 1,500 in one order, settled on the chain in one transaction.

steps.title: Make Alice
steps.text: Every action on a blockchain is signed by a key. This step creates Alice's key, which is how she proves she is Alice.

steps.title: Make Bob
steps.text: Bob gets his own key too, so he can act separately from Alice.

steps.title: Start a chain
steps.text: A chain is a private practice network, like a sandbox. This makes a fresh one and gives Alice and Bob some of its native coin to pay fees.

steps.title: Create the pound token
steps.text: A token is a made-up currency tracked by a program on the chain. Alice creates pounds (GBP, two decimal places) and receives all one million of them.

steps.title: Create the dollar token
steps.text: Bob creates dollars (USD, six decimal places) and receives all one million of them.

steps.title: Put up a settlement contract
steps.text: Here the list of offers is kept off the chain, in this browser, and only the final swaps go on the chain. Alice puts up the small program that checks and settles them.

steps.title: Alice allows the settlement contract to move her pounds
steps.text: Alice will offer 2,000 pounds in two parts. Her pounds stay in her account until someone buys, so she allows the settlement contract to take up to 2,000 of them then.

steps.title: Alice offers 1,000 pounds at 1.2700 dollars each
steps.text: Alice signs a limit order: sell 1,000 pounds, at no less than 1.2700 dollars each. Signing costs nothing and sends nothing to the chain.

steps.title: Alice offers 1,000 more at 1.2800
steps.text: A second offer at a higher price sits behind the first: buyers get the cheaper one first.

steps.title: Bob allows the settlement contract to move his dollars
steps.text: Bob will pay at most 1.2800 dollars for each of 1,500 pounds, so he allows up to 2,000 of his dollars to be taken.

steps.title: Bob buys 1,500 pounds at up to 1.2800
steps.text: Bob buys 1,500 pounds at no more than 1.2800 each. The app matches him with Alice's signed offers and sends one transaction that settles all of the first and half of the second.

steps.title: See the book
steps.text: Here is the market now: the 500 pounds still offered at 1.2800, the two trades, and Alice's orders.
